searchText: Why didn't the transfer work? Is it dead? are there the usual monitoring tools up for Ropsten? (blockcha.in, transaction explorer, etc) For the execution side there is https://ropsten.etherscan.io/ Consensus side there is https://beaconchain.ropsten.ethdevops.io/ and I believe a more official explorer coming soon. ^ looks like that beaconchain instance is pointing to goerli.etherscan for eth1 block data: https://beaconchain.ropsten.ethdevops.io/block/8763 --> https://goerli.etherscan.io/block/0x46deeb7f5b67f1d431d8af93891625a0fb713a5b0f8cf738777649a2e4351ee3 I mean in the UI, not that it's configured for the wrong EL or anything like that. its just a temp beaconchain instance, the real one will come out this week 🙂 <@199561711278227457> can you say a word about how msf6 went? hope there were no major issues 🙂 Yep everything looks pretty good, some small issues with besu wrt peering (but they recovered) and erigon had some problems awesome, thanks Marius and everyone who did their part 🙂 I didn't do anything for MSF6, Pari is the genius behind all this! 😄 Yea sorry, they got too routine to make writeups about 😄 Like Marius said, just some small issues we'd still need sorted out. Mainly relating to some proposals timing out and including 0 tx's (but still proposing) + some issues with certain erigon-cl combinations. In general the network is finalizing, healthy participation rates and proposals. Thanks for the write up! I have liked seeing Nimbus-Besu and Nimbus-Erigon come online as validators the last couple of these shadow forks
